biotools.summary:
In silico derivatization for GC.

The GC-derivatization tool converts carbonyl groups to C═N-OCH3 (MeOX) and transforms acidic protons into -Si(CH3)3 (TMS). Key functionalities include checking for specific groups, removing derivatization groups, and adding derivatization groups to molecules.
